entries.title: A held batch merges as soon as its failed tests pass on a rerun
entries.body: On a project with batched pull requests, a held batch no longer waits to be rebuilt with a test fix once its failed tests pass on a rerun. The crewmate repairing it can say the batch passed, and it merges as it is. A fix for the flaky test goes in with the next batch.
entries.noPicture: This changes when a held batch merges; no screen looks different.
